name: Token Insights
description: A themed dashboard for the tokens you have spent on this machine: trends, models, projects, rhythm, streak, and an optional cost estimate from your own price table.
author: PI-Desktop
changelog: First release: hero totals with period delta, 12-month activity heatmap, model and project rankings, hourly and weekday rhythm, streak, user-supplied price table, and a token_usage_summary agent tool.
safetyNotes: Reads aggregate token counts from local sessions only. It never reads message content, never writes to your data, and never touches the network.

agentTools.name: token_usage_summary
agentTools.description: Summarize local token usage: totals, per-model and per-project rankings, busiest hours, activity streak, and estimated cost when the user has filled in a price table. Use it for questions like 'which model cost me the most this month' or 'how many tokens did I use last week'.

since.description: Start of the window, inclusive. ISO date or date-time (2026-07-01), or a relative shorthand such as 7d, 30d, 12w, 1y.

until.description: End of the window, exclusive. ISO date or date-time. Defaults to now.

groupBy.description: Which ranking to expand in the reply. Defaults to model.

limit.description: Max rows in the expanded ranking (default 10, max 25).

settings.title: Currency
settings.description: ISO code used to render estimated cost, e.g. USD, EUR, CNY, JPY.

settings.title: Price table
settings.description: Your own price per million tokens, keyed by model id: { "model-id": { "input": 3, "output": 15, "cacheRead": 0.3, "cacheWrite": 3.75 } }. Models you leave out are shown without a cost. No vendor prices ship with this plugin.
